name: Direct employee purchase path
description: The employees purchase the business directly from the owner. Structured per Employee Ownership Journey v0.2's direct-purchase path; seeded values are starting points to confirm or replace.

seed_assumptions.name: Employee group can organize a purchasing entity
seed_assumptions.description: The working assumption that the employees form or engage a legal entity able to sign and finance the purchase.

seed_assumptions.name: Seller-financed portion of the price
seed_assumptions.description: The owner's working assumption for how much of the price the employees will ask the seller to finance.

seed_assumptions.name: Purchase price the employees can raise
seed_assumptions.description: A starting price band the employee group believes it can finance, to be replaced by a professional valuation.

seed_unknowns.description: How many employees are actual prospective buyers — and how much capital each can commit — is unknown.
seed_unknowns.required_action: Survey the employee group for genuine buyer interest and capacity before relying on this path.

seed_unknowns.description: The legal structure for a direct employee purchase (cooperative, trust, or share purchase agreement) is undecided.
